rationale: The Court is likely to reverse on a narrow ground: rejecting any categorical Rule 12 requirement to plead a named “meaningful benchmark,” while reaffirming that underperformance-based imprudence claims must still allege sufficient comparative context (risk/fees/objectives/alternatives) to be plausible. Separate writings are most likely from the dissenters to emphasize ERISA’s “circumstances then prevailing/like capacity” text and from one or more majority justices to stress either access-to-information concerns or the limits of the holding.
